changelog: Order 15: OpenClaw College Content Loop — full skill lifecycle pipeline (create, validate, publish, install, use, optimize, republish). Adds SkillQualityGate (14-point check), SkillAuthoringService, SkillPublishingService with LocalFolderProvider, SkillMetricsService, SkillRollbackService, and 17 new API endpoints. 3 new native tools: dojo_author_skill, dojo_validate_skill, dojo_publish_skill.
